verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it can generate new presentation decks from outlines and read existing ones, so deck creation is a first-party capability. Its documented conversational editing covers only websites it builds and publishes, not files. missing for 10: document/word-processing file creation, iterative editing of decks or documents, export formats and download flow, other file types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export

citations.quote: read existing decks, generate new ones from outlines.
You can ask jo to build and publish a real website, then change it conversationally.
